scope: Reopen the previously saved locally authored AC1024 mixed planar entity and sparse material drawing in the same macOS ARM64 LibreCAD candidate.
observation: The native Open Drawing panel selected the exact hash-matched saved file. The application displayed its filename, RAWTEST layer, loaded-document message and rendered drawing without an intervening error dialog. The process mapped the recorded shared codec. The previous independent readback checks the six translated geometries and material graph; visual reopening alone does not check hidden metadata.
limits: This is one previously generated drawing and an earlier codec input, not final-head, cross-platform, native attribute inspection or general interoperability qualification.
